recognize_zh: Kappa 原位雜交（ISH）在深層真皮與脂肪交界處可見大量細胞質呈深藍色強訊號的漿細胞樣細胞，成群分布；與同區 lambda ISH 僅零星陽性相比呈明顯 kappa 偏斜，支持單株性漿細胞分化的皮膚邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Numerous plasmacytic cells with strong dark blue cytoplasmic kappa mRNA signal
Positive cells form clusters and sheets within the deep dermis adjacent to subcutaneous fat
Background of signal-negative lymphoid cells (pink counterstain)
Positive cells are far more numerous than lambda-positive cells in the parallel section (kappa restriction)
describe_en: Kappa light-chain mRNA in situ hybridization on the skin biopsy shows numerous strongly positive plasmacytic cells arranged in clusters within the deep dermis near the subcutaneous fat, admixed with signal-negative lymphoid cells. When compared with the lambda in situ hybridization, which shows only rare positive cells, there is a marked kappa predominance indicating light-chain restriction. Findings support a monotypic plasmacytic component consistent with primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous lymphoid hyperplasia with reactive plasma cells
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells show a mixed kappa:lambda ratio of roughly 2:1, rather than the marked kappa excess seen against the paired lambda stain.
Plasmacytoma consists of sheets of monotypic plasma cells without the background marginal zone B-cell infiltrate and reactive follicles.

ddx.dx: Syphilis or other plasma cell-rich dermatitis
ddx.vs: Infectious plasma cell-rich infiltrates are polytypic and often show endothelial swelling and spirochetes by IHC.
